deltas.title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 10.7 Emoticon Gifts
deltas.vocab:
seaweed: 해초, 미역
don't care much for: 별로 신경쓰지 않다
over and over: 반복하다
puzzled: 어리둥절해하는, 얼떨떨한, 의아한
deltas.sentences:

I got bored of using the same ones over and over.
They were a little puzzled.

deltas.title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 10.8 Playground Laughter
deltas.vocab:
go out: 밖에 나가 놀다
exception: 예외
tag: 술래잡기
lost track of time: 시간가는 줄 모르다
cheer on: 응원한다
in my heart: 마음속으로
to one's heart's content: 실컷 놀다
deltas.sentences:
He didn't go out much last year.
We played tag and lost track of time.
I cheer him on in my heart.
Kids need to play to their hearts' content.
